description: This is a shell script designed for testing the functionality of Git bundle commands, including creation, verification, fetching, and cloning of Git bundles, as well as handling edge cases and errors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test expecting success, runs the enclosed commands, and reports success or failure.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; reports success if it fails.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs for equality.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new Git repository for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specific path does not exist.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets commands to run after tests for cleanup.

methods.name: test_oid
methods.description: Outputs the object ID format or version.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock or simulates time passage.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches input for a pattern and verifies presence or absence.
